description: Umbrella implementation issue for OpenSpec change add-grant-linked-repositories. Coordinates child workstreams for GitHub repository binding, deterministic artifact publication, browser exposure, docs, and verification. Implementation must follow TDD: each child writes failing tests for its owned behavior before production code.
acceptance_criteria: OpenSpec change add-grant-linked-repositories remains valid; all child workstreams are closed; browser, REST, JSON-RPC, publication, audit, and documentation verification are reported; no implementation work starts without red tests in the responsible child stream.

title: Model grant repository bindings and effective resolution
description: Own repository binding fields, persistence updates, public projections, and shared service helpers that resolve the effective GitHub repository for tracked grants, catalog grants, proposal workspaces, and application workspaces. Proposal workspace bindings override inherited grant/catalog bindings only when explicitly set or when the workspace is manual. No REST/browser/publication-specific logic.
acceptance_criteria: First write failing domain tests for binding persistence, replacement, clearing, default grantfinder/ root path, Privy-linked GitHub credential requirement, manual workspace binding, explicit proposal override, inherited catalog/tracked-grant resolution, application effective binding reads, and binding-source metadata; then implement the minimum domain/persistence/service changes to pass; no publication or UI behavior is implemented in this stream.
close_reason: Domain repository binding model implemented and verified

title: Expose repository binding APIs and workspace aggregates
description: Own REST and JSON-RPC attach/update/clear/read flows plus workspace aggregate exposure for effective repository binding metadata, binding source, and sync status. Build on the shared domain model without taking on publication logic.
acceptance_criteria: First write failing REST and JSON-RPC tests for tracked-grant, catalog-grant, and manual proposal-workspace attach/update/clear/read flows; include default grantfinder/ root behavior, missing GitHub-linked credential errors, workspace aggregate tests for effective binding source and sync status exposure; then implement the minimum API/service routing needed to pass; do not implement GitHub write behavior here.
close_reason: Repository binding REST and JSON-RPC APIs plus workspace aggregate exposure implemented and verified

title: Build GitHub publication plumbing and audit sync status
description: Own Privy-linked-GitHub publication helpers, deterministic repository paths, Grantfinder branch naming, pull request creation/update, execution audit records, and persisted latest sync status. This is the shared publication substrate for research and proposal flows.
acceptance_criteria: First write failing tests for deterministic path construction, stable Grantfinder branch naming, pull request creation, pull request update, Privy-linked GitHub credential compatibility checks, missing-write-access blocked status, successful branch/PR/commit metadata, failed publication metadata, execution audit records, and latest sync status persistence; then implement the minimum publication plumbing to pass; do not hook research/proposal flows in this stream.
close_reason: GitHub repository publication plumbing, audit records, and latest sync status persistence implemented and verified
